Incident and change carry their own (ITSM-016 40 %, ITSM-094 30 %). The problem reference rate is ITSM-067's ratio ("problems with both CI and service references empty; report as a ratio"), which the workbook gives no threshold for — problem_reference_threshold is UNDEFINED, so the rule is UNCONFIGURED until it is set. It fires only when all three breach.
